findings.passage: "As I meet and talk with constituents in our area and across our state, election security is top of mind," Sweet said.
findings.note: Press release from the Indiana House caucus quoting her on why she filed a bill on how ballots are cast and counted. Related election-integrity material, not about ID.

House Bill 1286, the Trust and Transparency in Elections Act, would remove electronic voting machines, electronic poll books and ballot marking devices and require hand-marked, hand-counted paper ballots made in Indiana with a watermark and serial numbers. The release says it was assigned to the House Elections and Apportionment Committee. Related election-integrity bill, not about ID.
